issues.description: The solution's Person class makes the firstName field public, whereas the template declares it private with public getter/setter methods. This visibility difference between template and solution is an unintended structural inconsistency: students working from the template will expect fields to be private and use getters/setters, but the solution uses a public field. While this does not prevent the functionality from working, it is a surprising divergence that can confuse students when they compare their template-based code to the reference solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution's Person.firstName field have the same visibility as the template (private) and keep using the public getter/setter. Concretely, change 'public String firstName;' in the solution to 'private String firstName;'. This keeps the class design consistent across template and solution and avoids student confusion.
